options.name: allow_merge_on_skipped_pipeline
options.description: Allow merge when skipped pipelines exist.

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: avatar_path
options.description: Absolute path image to configure avatar. File size should not exceed 200 kb. This option is only used on creation, not for updates.

options.name: build_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds a CI job can run. If not specified on creation, GitLab imposes a default value.

options.name: builds_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that repository CI/CD is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that repository CI/CD is disabled. V(enabled) means that repository CI/CD is enabled.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: ci_config_path
options.description: Custom path to the CI configuration file for this project.

options.name: container_expiration_policy
options.description: Project cleanup policy for its container registry.

options.name: container_registry_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that container registry is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that container registry is disabled. V(enabled) means that container registry is enabled.

options.name: default_branch
options.description: The default branch name for this project. For project creation, this option requires O(initialize_with_readme=true). For project update, the branch must exist. Supports project's default branch update since community.general 8.0.0.

options.name: description
options.description: An description for the project.

options.name: environments_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that deployment to environment is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that deployment to environment is disabled. V(enabled) means that deployment to environment is enabled.

options.name: feature_flags_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that feature rollout is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that feature rollout is disabled. V(enabled) means that feature rollout is enabled.

options.name: forking_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that repository forks is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that repository forks are disabled. V(enabled) means that repository forks are enabled.

options.name: group
options.description: ID or the full path of the group of which this projects belongs to.

options.name: import_url
options.description: Git repository which is imported into gitlab. GitLab server needs read access to this git repository.

options.name: infrastructure_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that configuring infrastructure is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that configuring infrastructure is disabled. V(enabled) means that configuring infrastructure is enabled.

options.name: initialize_with_readme
options.description: Initializes the project with a default C(README.md). Is only used when the project is created, and ignored otherwise.

options.name: issues_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that accessing issues tab is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that accessing issues tab is disabled. V(enabled) means that accessing issues tab is enabled. O(issues_access_level) and O(issues_enabled) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: issues_enabled
options.description: Whether you want to create issues or not. O(issues_access_level) and O(issues_enabled) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: lfs_enabled
options.description: Enable Git large file systems to manages large files such as audio, video, and graphics files.

options.name: merge_method
options.description: What requirements are placed upon merges. Possible values are V(merge), V(rebase_merge) merge commit with semi-linear history, V(ff) fast-forward merges only.

options.name: merge_requests_enabled
options.description: If merge requests can be made or not.

options.name: model_registry_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that accessing model registry tab is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that accessing model registry tab is disabled. V(enabled) means that accessing model registry tab is enabled.

options.name: monitor_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that monitoring health is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that monitoring health is disabled. V(enabled) means that monitoring health is enabled.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the project.

options.name: only_allow_merge_if_all_discussions_are_resolved
options.displayName: Only Allow Merge If All Discussions Are Resolved
options.description: All discussions on a merge request (MR) have to be resolved.

options.name: only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds
options.displayName: Only Allow Merge If Pipeline Succeeds
options.description: Only allow merges if pipeline succeeded.

options.name: packages_enabled
options.description: Enable GitLab package repository.

options.name: pages_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that accessing pages tab is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that accessing pages tab is disabled. V(enabled) means that accessing pages tab is enabled.

options.name: path
options.description: The path of the project you want to create, this is server_url/O(group)/O(path). If not supplied, O(name) is used.

options.name: releases_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that accessing release is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that accessing release is disabled. V(enabled) means that accessing release is enabled.

options.name: remove_source_branch_after_merge
options.description: Remove the source branch after merge.

options.name: repository_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that accessing repository is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that accessing repository is disabled. V(enabled) means that accessing repository is enabled.

options.name: security_and_compliance_access_level
options.description: V(private) means that accessing security and complicance tab is allowed only to project members. V(disabled) means that accessing security and complicance tab is disabled. V(enabled) means that accessing security and complicance tab is enabled.

options.name: service_desk_enabled
options.description: Enable Service Desk.

options.name: shared_runners_enabled
options.description: Enable shared runners for this project.

options.name: snippets_enabled
options.description: If creating snippets should be available or not.

options.name: squash_option
options.description: Squash commits when merging.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete project. Possible values are present and absent.

options.name: topics
options.description: A topic or list of topics to be assigned to a project. It is compatible with old GitLab server releases (versions before 14, correspond to C(tag_list)).

options.name: username
options.description: Used to create a personal project under a user's name.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.

options.name: visibility
options.description: V(private) Project access must be granted explicitly for each user. V(internal) The project can be cloned by any logged in user. V(public) The project can be cloned without any authentication.

options.name: wiki_enabled
options.description: If an wiki for this project should be available or not.
